title: qa scenarios: add one not-recorded ask question to an open dataset card (item 2 split from #35429)
body:
repo:objectstack#6 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjQkY5yXZrN9BEA3rEK

Filing gate: ③ follow-up of an accepted delivery. Split from #35429 (item 2) by seat repo:objectstack#6; #35429's PR #37443 lands items 1 and 3 only.

## What is owed (verbatim from #35138 comment 6983113781, carried on #35429)

"One ask-card question for an object or field that is not recorded, in #35113's open ask cards."

## Why it was split

Both open dataset ask cards already ask 10 questions. The mid-tier band in `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` ("8–10 questions") and the pins `order-to-cash.test.ts:184` / `travel-expense.test.ts:159` (`toBeLessThanOrEqual(10)`) cap them, so one more question reds tests outside #35429's file surface.

## Options the previous dev reported (handoff 7183583455 on #35429)

- A: widen the band to 8–11 and add one `order_to_cash` question naming a field `sales_order` lacks (e.g. a discount). Recommended there.
- B: replace an existing question.
- C: reword `september_commission` to name a field.

## Also noted (PR #35408 Acceptance notes, carried on #35429)

The open citation grader (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-run-grade.ts`, `SOURCE_LINE`) reads `Source:` / `来源：` but not `來源：` / `出典：`. Fold it in only if a zh-Hant or ja question is added.

Suggested-grade: p3 · eval-card coverage follow-up, no user-visible defect.
Dedupe: `not-recorded ask question` found only #35429 and #35138.
